description: Validate an IBAN offline: country, length and check digits (ISO 13616), SEPA membership and – for German IBANs – bank code (BLZ) and account number. Catches typos before a payment or invoice goes out. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

iban.description: IBAN, with or without spaces, e.g. DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00.
